messages:
Anya: quick sync 9— need a crisp split of responsibilities between ControlPlane vs Runtime across hosted/dedicated/private. focus: lifecycle ops (start/stop/upgrade), telemetry export paths, cache isolation.

Sam: +1. prefer a tiny runtime interface so adapters don't balloon. but we need enough hooks for canary/rollouts.

Devon: my pragmatic minimal runtime surface:
- StartInstance(params)
- StopInstance(instance_id)
- UpgradeInstance(instance_id, mode)
- RouteRequest(req)
- GetCacheStats(prefix)
- EmitTelemetry(event, payload)

Maria: EmitTelemetry is policy-sensitive. private bundles often forbid outbound calls. we need a telemetry_sink config: "none" | "sidecar" | "controlplane" and a local buffer mode.

Anya: proposal: keep API surface identical for adapters, but behavior controlled by deployment_mode. hosted: telemetry->controlplane by default; dedicated: opt-in push; private: default none, sidecar available.

Sam: identical surface simplifies SDKs, but runtime must implement forwarding logic and buffering for sidecars. that increases runtime code in adapters.

Devon: alternative: split into ControlPlaneAPI (rich lifecycle + rollout commands) and RuntimeAPI (hot path only). RuntimeAPI is required for private; ControlPlaneAPI optional for hosted/dedicated.

Maria: i like the split. downside: adapters might need to implement two interfaces. mitigate with a shim in the SDK that implements ControlPlaneAPI on top of RuntimeAPI when control plane features are absent.

Anya: exactly. ship a small shim lib with adapters. it should fall back gracefully and surface clear errors when a control-plane-only call is invoked on a runtime-only deployment.

Sam: rollout semantics: hosted wants central canary/gradual upgrades; private wants customer-managed windows. we should add an UpgradeMode enum on UpgradeInstance: {"immediate","canary:percentage","windowed"} and let control-plane assert policy.

Devon: cache isolation note: hosted/dedicated can enable shared prefix caching; private must assume local-only. add CacheIsolation: {"tenant_shared","global_shared","local"} and make expectations explicit in SDK docs.

Maria: security: private customers require local KMS/HSM for signing and key storage. the shim must support a LocalKMSAdapter interface and avoid exporting keys. include a KeySigningAPI that returns signatures rather than raw keys.

Devon: also add a capability discovery call: GetAdapterCapabilities() so control plane can detect supported features (telemetry modes, cache levels, kms support).

Sam: ops/infra ask: ensure any default that calls home is flagged in build configs. we should run a scan on private bundles.

ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket INF-4123: "private-build telemetry audit". config gate will flag adapters with default outbound telemetry.

Anya: next steps / owners:
- Sam: draft RFC for ControlPlaneAPI vs RuntimeAPI split + shim approach (due Thu EOD)
- Devon: enumerate RuntimeAPI signatures, CacheIsolation enum, and capability discovery payload (due Mon)
- Maria: telemetry privacy proposal describing sidecar proxy pattern and buffer/backoff semantics (due Mon)
- Ops: infra audit & private build check (INF-4123) follow-up

Sam: +1. i'll ping arch-reviewers when RFC is up.

Maria: minor add: document KMS flow for private (no key export; sign locally), and list supported HSM integrations.

Anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
